name: vllm_ggml_moe_a8
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench vLLM test_ggml_moe_a8.py. GGML Q8_0 (quant_type=8) MoE matmul over sorted/padded tokens via vLLM _custom_ops.ggml_moe_a8. X (tokens*top_k, hidden) fp32 is plain random. W (num_experts, row, (hidden//32)*34) uint8 is a valid Q8_0 buffer built vectorized in gen_inputs (positive fp16 scale bytes + random int8 payload). sorted_token_ids=arange(nt) int32, expert_ids=randint(0,num_experts) int32, num_tokens_post_padded=[nt] int32 also built in gen_inputs. quant_type, row, top_k, tokens are scalars. Returns the fp32 output. No torch fallback; requires vLLM at eval time.
